text.en: This Act may be cited as the Emblems and Names Short title (Prevention of Improper Use) Act.

In this Act unless the context otherwise requires - tion "competent authority" means any authority comunder any law for the time being in force to register any company, firm or other body of persons, or any trade mark or design, or to grant a emblem" means any emblems, seal, flag, pennant, insignia, formation sign, ensign or coat-of-arms specified in Part I of the Schedule; name" means any name specified in Part II of the Schedule and includes any abbreviation of any such name.

(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any law Prohibition for the time being in force, no person shall, except with the of improper use of written permission of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-emblems,

(a) use any specified name or specified emblem, or any colourable imitation thereof, for the purpose of any trade, business, calling or profession; or B.L.R.O. 11/984 4 CAP. 94 Emblems and Names

(b) use· for the purposes of, or display as an advertisement for, any business, trade, calling or or sell, any photograph, drawing or other pictorial representation of His Majesty or Her Majesty the Raja Isteri; or

(c) use or continue to use any specified name or specified emblem, or any colourable imitation in the title of any patent, or in any trade or

(d) make for the purpose of sale or sell or have in his possession for sale, any specified emblem.

(2) The provisions of paragraph (b) of subsection (1) relating to the use of any photograph, drawing or other pictorial representation aforesaid shall not apply to the pubof news (whether in a newspaper or by any other medium) or to the publication of any article in a newspaper.

(3) His Majesty may subject any permission given under subsection (1) to such conditions as he may deem fit.

(b) register a trade mark or design which bears any emblem, name, photograph, drawing or other pictorial representation; or
